{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Load the data
sales_df = pd.read_csv('data/sales.csv')

# Convert revenue to numeric, coercing errors to NaN
sales_df['revenue'] = pd.to_numeric(sales_df['revenue'], errors='coerce')

# Filter for completed orders from LOYAL customers
loyal_completed = sales_df[(sales_df['customer_segment'] == 'loyal') & 
                           (sales_df['status'] == 'completed')]

# Calculate mean revenue for these orders
mean_revenue = loyal_completed['revenue'].mean()

# Check if there are any non-numeric revenue values in the filtered subset
non_numeric_in_filtered = loyal_completed[loyal_completed['revenue'].isnull()]

len(loyal_completed), mean_revenue, len(non_numeric_in_filtered), non_numeric_in_filtered.head()"}
